Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a normal return because it’s treated as a “quality of goods” issue, not a change of mind return.
For a normal return, the creator typically follows their own return policy (refund, exchange, etc.). For a damaged item, the creator usually resolves it by sending a replacement or issuing a refund for the damaged item.
One key difference: if you’re expecting a refund for the damage and it doesn’t happen in a timely way, the customer may file a payment dispute instead of waiting.
Also, refunds can be done per item (so you can refund just the damaged item, not the whole order).
